ai_summary: Aeroflex Industries Limited reported record Q2 FY27 results, with revenue exceeding INR 200 crores and a 157% year-on-year PAT growth, driven by strong demand and the rapidly growing liquid cooling vertical now comprising 24% of H1 revenue. The company is strategically investing INR 202 crores in capacity expansion for both its core business and liquid cooling solutions, projecting an incremental INR 500-550 crores annual revenue potential. However, the reported profitability was materially impacted by a change in depreciation method (WDV to SLM) which reduced expenses by INR 8.41 crores for Q2 and H1, warranting closer scrutiny.
